_comment: Illustrative defaults, not survey-calibrated. gain_w_per_m2 (25 W/m^2) approximates ASHRAE 90.1 Table 9.5.1 dining-area lighting power density (~1.0 W/ft^2 ~ 11 W/m^2) plus a substantial illustrative margin for commercial kitchen cooking equipment, which dominates a restaurant's actual equipment gain and isn't captured by LPD alone. Blended with (not replacing) the per-occupant gains -- see core/buem_adapter.py to_buem_profiles().
